en.question: An assistant turn returns two tool_use blocks in a single response. How must the application respond?

options.text: Send two consecutive user turns, each carrying one of the tool_result blocks.
options.note: Splitting across turns breaks the required alternation and orphans the first results.

options.text: Execute the first tool only and ignore the second as redundant.
options.note: An unanswered tool_use is rejected by the API.

options.text: Re-send the original request so the model settles on a single tool call.
options.note: Discards work the model already decided on and wastes a round trip.

options.text: Send one user turn containing a tool_result for each, matched by tool_use_id.

en.explanation: Every tool_use must be answered by a corresponding tool_result carrying the matching id, all inside the single following user turn. Omitting any of them is an API error.
